searchText: Kiln, Ropsten and Rinkeby are now considered deprecated. They will be sunset sequentially over roughly the next year. Users and developers should migrate to Sepolia & Goerli 🌆 Full announcement: https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/06/21/testnet-deprecation/

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content:
Kiln, Ropsten and Rinkeby are now considered deprecated. They will be sunset sequentially over roughly the next year. Users and developers should migrate to Sepolia & Goerli 🌆 

Full announcement: https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/06/21/testnet-deprecation/
